title: Rethinking the design space of Vanilla Pixel Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.23854v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models have recently re-emerged as a compelling alternative to latent diffusion, avoiding the lossy latent bottleneck and separately trained autoencoder. JiT shows that a vanilla diffusion transformer can generate directly in pixel space by replacing the commonly used velocity prediction ($\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction) with clean image prediction ($\boldsymbol{x_0}$-prediction). In this work, we revisit this choice and introduce MFlow, an adaptive parameterization that learns to interpolate between $\boldsymbol{x_0}$- and $\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction across principal directions of the data, learned end-to-end with diffusion training. We find that the preferred parameterization varies systematically with the data representation and model capacity -- notably, increasing model capacity shifts preference toward velocity prediction. We evaluate MFlow across ImageNet, UCF-101 video, and large-scale text-to-image generation

translated_title: 重新思考朴素像素扩散Transformer的设计空间
translated_abstract: 像素空间扩散模型最近重新崛起，成为潜在扩散的一种极具吸引力的替代方案，它避免了有损的潜在瓶颈以及需要单独训练的自编码器。JiT表明，通过将常用的速度预测（u-预测）替换为干净图像预测（x₀-预测），朴素的扩散Transformer可以直接在像素空间中生成图像。在本工作中，我们重新审视了这一选择，并提出了MFlow，一种自适应参数化方法，它学习在数据的主方向上对x₀-预测和u-预测之间进行插值，并通过扩散训练进行端到端学习。我们发现，首选的参数化方式会随数据表示和模型容量而系统性变化——值得注意的是，增加模型容量会使偏好转向速度预测。我们在ImageNet、UCF-101视频以及大规模文本到图像生成任务上对MFlow进行了评估。
tldr: 提出MFlow自适应参数化方法，可在x₀-预测和u-预测之间沿数据主方向进行插值学习，并发现最优参数化随数据表示和模型容量系统性变化，模型容量越大越偏向速度预测。
